{{Quote|I'm not comfortable with Jedi being seen as weapons. The Yuuzhan Vong are already attempting to turn public sentiment against us. Do we really want to be perceived as an aggressor in this war?|Lar Le'Ung, to Kyp Durron and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Inv2" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] '''Lar Le'Ung''', a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]], was a member of the [[New Jedi Order]] at the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], he was stationed at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] when [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Finn Galfridian]] was rescued from the [[Battle of Artorias|subjugation]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Artorias]] at the hands of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and brought to the Praxeum for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. When the Jedi were requested to aid in the [[Evacuation of Rychel|evacuation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rychel]], which was under attack from the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] invaders, Le'Ung was tasked with leading the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] against the Yuuzhan Vong.

The Yuuzhan Vong had deployed [[Biter and Beater|two siege creatures]]&mdash;[[Tu-Scart]] and [[Sgauru]]&mdash;and with Galfridian at his side, Le'Ung led the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in an attempt to distract the creatures long enough for Skywalker to rescue the refugees. As the battle wore on, the Republic troops lost hope and began to run back to their [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Le'Ung realized that Tu-Scart was emanating fear and, knowing the refugees needed more time, raised his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and called for his troops to hold. As he did so, the Pau'an was attacked from behind by a [[Tsalok|Yuuzhan Vong warrior]] who stabbed Le'Ung through the chest and hurled the Jedi Master into the open mouth of Tu-Scart.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Come on, we must keep those siege creatures away from the evacuation ships.|Lar Le'Ung, during the evacuation of Rychel|<ref name="Inv3" />}}
[[File:JediMastersSkywalkerLeUngAndDurron-Invasion2.jpg|left|thumb|Master Le'Ung with Luke Skywalker and Kyp Durron on Yavin 4]]
A [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[New Jedi Order]], the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] Lar Le'Ung was stationed at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], just months after a [[Species/Legends|species]] of intergalactic invaders, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], began their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attack]] on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Inv2" /> At the Praxeum, Le'Ung was one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who oversaw the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentices]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and [[Anakin Solo]].<ref name="Inv0">[[Invasion 0|''Invasion'' 0]]</ref> Le'Ung was present when leading Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] brought [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Finn Galfridian]] to the Praxeum to be trained as a Jedi after Galfridian's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Artorias]] was [[Battle of Artorias|subjugated]] by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Inv2" />

After Galfridian and some of his fellow apprentices encountered a [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]]&mdash;an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sithspawn/Legends|creature]]&mdash;in Yavin 4's jungle, Le'Ung, Skywalker, and Master [[Kyp Durron]] discussed Galfridian's future as a Jedi. Their discussion was interrupted, however, by news of a Yuuzhan Vong attack on the planet [[Rychel]] and a request for the Jedi to aid in the [[Evacuation of Rychel|evacuation]] of the world. Leaving Durron behind to watch over the Praxeum, Skywalker and Le'Ung left to lead the mission, taking Galfridian with them.<ref name="Inv2" />

While en route to Rychel, Le'Ung briefed the Jedi team on their mission objectives and the current situation from onboard one of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] [[Bulwark Mark III|''Bulwark''-class battle cruisers]]. The Pau'an was given command of the Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] that were participating in the mission, with orders to distract [[Biter and Beater|two siege creatures]]&mdash;[[Sgauru]] and [[Tu-Scart]]&mdash;that the Yuuzhan Vong had deployed, while Skywalker attempted to rescue and evacuate the planet's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. With Galfridian at his side, Le'Ung led the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] against the [[coufee]]-armed [[Chazrach]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] warriors and siege creatures fighting for the Yuuzhan Vong, while air support in the form of [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter]]s assaulted the creatures from the sky. Tu-Scart managed to bring down several of the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] without suffering any damage itself, with one of the downed fighters crashing perilously close to Le'Ung and his troops.<ref name="Inv3" />

As Republic fighters crashed around them, Le'Ung's troops lost hope after realizing that their weapons were having little effect on the siege creature and began to run back to their [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Nonetheless, the Jedi Master recognized that they were not just fighting the creature itself; it was emanating fear. The Pau'an raised his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in the air and called for his troops to hold, knowing the refugees needed more time. Just at that moment, however, he was stabbed from behind by a [[Tsalok|Yuuzhan Vong warrior]] wielding an [[amphistaff]]. The warrior drove his weapon right through Le'Ung's chest and hurled the Jedi Master's body into the maw of Tu-Scart, the sight of which renewed the fear that afflicted the Republic forces.<ref name="Inv3" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|You wielded this lightsaber once before on Rychel. You used it wisely and with compassion. May it always be so.|Luke Skywalker, upon giving Finn Galfridian Lar Le'Ung's lightsaber|<ref name="Inv6">[[Invasion: Rescues 1|''Invasion: Rescues'' 1]]</ref>}}
As the battle continued, Galfridian retrieved Le'Ung's fallen lightsaber and attempted to rally the Republic troops yet again to continue their attack on the siege creatures. The troops managed to repel the beasts long enough for Skywalker to fill the evacuation ships with the civilians, though many of the natives were left behind. When the evacuation ships left, Galfridian wanted to return for Le'Ung, but Skywalker told the young man the Pau'an was gone.<ref name="Inv3" /> Later, when Galfridian resolved to return to his home planet, Skywalker gave the young Jedi Le'Ung's lightsaber, noting that he had used it with compassion.<ref name="Inv6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Hold'', troops! We need to buy more time for those evacuating. It's just a ''big snake''. There is ''nothing'' to ''fear'' here.|Lar Le'Ung rallying his troops|<ref name="Inv3" />}}
[[File:LeUngDeath.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Le'Ung's death during the evacuation of Rychel]]
Lar Le'Ung was a Pau'an with pale skin. Forgoing conventional [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], Jedi Master Le'Ung dressed in traditional Pau'an clothing and carried a cane.<ref name="Inv2" /> A respected member of the New Jedi Order, Le'Ung was involved in the training of Jedi apprentices at the Praxeum on Yavin 4<ref name="Inv0" /> and was called upon by Master Luke Skywalker to discuss the future of Finn Galfridian. During the discussion, the Pau'an revealed that he was uncomfortable with the Jedi being seen as weapons, unlike his contemporary Kyp Durron.<ref name="Inv2" /> When the Jedi were called upon to aid in the evacuation of Rychel, Le'Ung performed the mission briefing and was tasked by Skywalker with leading the Republic troops in the battle.<ref name="Inv3" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Can you feel it, Finn? We're not just fighting the creature itself&hellip;''"<br />"''It's emanating ''fear''!|Lar Le'Ung and Finn Galfridian, during the evacuation of Rychel|<ref name="Inv3" />}}
A powerful Jedi, Le'Ung was capable with a lightsaber as well as in the [[Force power/Legends|use]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. During the evacuation of Rychel, he fought the Yuuzhan Vong and their war creatures with his orange-bladed lightsaber and was able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] the fear that Tu-Scart was emanating. Due to the Yuuzhan Vong being invisible to the effects of the Force, however, Le'Ung was unable to sense the impending attack from a Yuuzhan Vong warrior, leading to the Jedi Master's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Inv3" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My friend Tom Taylor just penned the latest official comic book, ''Star Wars: Invasion'', released in July. He has kindly named a character after me. I'm now inside the Star Wars universe &hellip; and finally I'm a Jedi.|Lawrence Leung|<ref name="the age">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theage.com.au/news/entertainment/film/the-teatowel-was-my-jedi-robe/2009/06/03/1243708503547.html?page=2|text='The teatowel was my Jedi robe'|author=Lawrence Leung|date=2009-06-04|format=HTML|pages=2|archivedate=20171001210222}}</ref>}}
Lar Le'Ung first appeared in the second issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, [[Invasion 2|''Refugees, Part 2'']], released in [[August]] [[2009]], and known only as "Master Le'Ung."<ref name="Inv2" /> He went on to appear in the third issue of the series, [[Invasion 3|''Refugees, Part 3'']], in which his first name "Lar" was revealed.<ref name="Inv3" /> Le'Ung later made a small appearance in [[Invasion 0|''Star Wars: Invasion'' 0]], which collected and expanded the two [[StarWars.com]] online previews for ''Invasion''.<ref name="Inv0" /> All of the issues in which Le'Ung appeared were written by [[Tom Taylor]] and penciled by [[Colin Wilson (artist)|Colin Wilson]].<ref name="Inv2" /><ref name="Inv3" /> Taylor named Le'Ung after his friend, Australian comedian and ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan, [[Wikipedia:Lawrence Leung|Lawrence Leung]].<ref name="the age" />
